requirement.original: Harden the timeline view's degenerate entry filtering and optional item deduplication in generate-html-interactive.py
requirement.clarified: Audit and fix five specific weaknesses in TimelineView's add() filter, dedup key, firstH/lastH calculation, and top() helper so that malformed or edge-case data cannot produce invisible or misaligned timeline entries.
requirement.what: Five targeted hardening changes to the TimelineView JSX component within scripts/generate-html-interactive.py
requirement.why: Filtering logic added during the current session has correctness gaps (end-time sentinel not checked, dedup key too coarse, lastH uses start not end, firstH/top not NaN-safe) that can silently produce broken timeline renders on real trip data.

included: add() guard: numeric zero-duration check via timeToMinutes
Dedup key: include stable name identifier to avoid over-deduplication
lastH: compute from max(time.end) across all deduped entries, cap at 24

success_criteria: Entries with time.end === '00:00' are not rendered in timeline
Two optional items with same type and slot but different names are both rendered
firstH is never NaN regardless of entry data
lastH extends to cover the actual end time of the last activity
No new regressions in existing timeline rendering
constraints: All fixes must be within the TimelineView function body (lines 2535-end of component)
timeToMinutes is already in scope and must be reused, not duplicated
Do not alter the computeColumnLayout function
Do not alter any Python layer code

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Timeline may render no entries or drop distinct optional items due to logic gaps in filtering and deduplication added this session.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Four independent logic gaps: (1) add() checks start!='00:00' but not end!='00:00'; (2) dedup key uses only type+slot, collapsing distinct named alternatives; (3) lastH reads start+2 instead of max(end); (4) firstH/top do not guard against NaN from parseInt on malformed strings.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - logic gaps in code added this session, not a regression from a prior commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Filters were added incrementally to handle specific known cases (N/A breakfast, zero-duration slots) without a systematic audit of all degenerate input combinations.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Each gap is individually minor but collectively they can combine: a day where the last entry ends at 23:00 will have its final hour clipped (lastH bug), AND if that entry is optional and shares a slot with another of the same type with a different name, one is silently dropped (dedup key bug).
root_cause_analysis.timeline: All gaps introduced in current session (2026-04-05 to 2026-04-06).

dependencies.timeToMinutes: already in scope at line 2474, splits HH:MM and returns h*60+m

development_approach.strategy: Make five targeted in-place edits to the TimelineView function body. Each edit is independent and can be made in any order. No new helper functions needed beyond reusing timeToMinutes.

specific_changes.description: Add rejection of time.end === '00:00' and use timeToMinutes for numeric zero-duration check
specific_changes.target_code:
if (item?.time?.start && item?.time?.end
        && item.time.start !== '00:00'
        && item.time.end !== '00:00'
        && timeToMinutes(item.time.start) !== timeToMinutes(item.time.end))

specific_changes.description: Add stable name component to dedup key so distinct named optional items at same slot are not collapsed
specific_changes.target_code:
const name = e.name_base || e.title || e._label || '';
    const key = slot + ':' + e._type + ':' + name;

specific_changes.description: Add NaN fallback so corrupt time.start does not propagate NaN into pixel calculations
Compute lastH from the actual maximum time.end across all entries instead of last entry's start+2
Clamp result to >= 0 to prevent negative pixel offsets from stray entries with start < firstH
specific_changes.current_code: const top = (t) => { const [h, m] = t.split(':').map(Number); return (h - firstH) * hH + (m / 60) * hH; };
specific_changes.target_code: const top = (t) => { const [h, m] = t.split(':').map(Number); return Math.max(0, (h - firstH) * hH + (m / 60) * hH); };

development_approach.validation_approach: QA should verify: (1) a day with a breakfast entry having time 00:00-00:00 renders without that entry; (2) a day with two optional entertainment entries at identical slots but different names shows both; (3) a day ending at 23:00 has its final hour visible in the grid; (4) no NaN values appear in computed CSS top/height for any entry.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward bug-fix audit of existing session code; root causes are concrete logic gaps identified directly from reading the source, no architectural decisions or pattern choices involved.
